_snapshot_note: Hand-seeded snapshot of Apple's required-reason API categories and a representative subset of their approved reason codes, current as of the sources gathered for this project. Not fetched live — see plan.md scope notes.

allowed_reasons.CA92.1: Access info from the same app, per app group, not shared with third parties
allowed_reasons.1C8F.1: Access info from the same app, no app group
allowed_reasons.AC6B.1: A third-party SDK accesses its own CFPreferences suite for internal functionality
allowed_reasons.3EC4.1: Access user defaults via a wrapper method not exposed directly to the app

NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestam.description: Reading file or directory timestamp attributes (creation, modification, access)

allowed_reasons.C617.1: Display file timestamps to the user within the app's own UI
allowed_reasons.DDA9.1: Access timestamps of files inside the app's own container or app group
allowed_reasons.3B52.1: Timestamps used only for file management inside the app's own container

NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategorySystemBootTi.description: Reading system boot time (e.g. via systemUptime)

allowed_reasons.35F9.1: Measure time elapsed between events or processes within the app itself
allowed_reasons.8FFB.1: Calculate absolute timestamps for events that occurred within the app

NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace.description: Reading available or total disk space

allowed_reasons.E174.1: Check available disk space before writing app-generated content, or to display it to the user
allowed_reasons.85F4.1: Free up disk space when low, as part of the app's own functionality

NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryActiveKeyboa.description: Reading the list of active or installed keyboards

allowed_reasons.3EC4.1: Customize the app's own UI or text input behavior based on active keyboards
allowed_reasons.54BD.1: Enable text input functionality for the app's own custom keyboard extension
